```css
.dashboard {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── Header ── */
.dash-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.dash-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.name-highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jl-primary), #19b27a);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.dash-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.btn-refresh {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.btn-refresh:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  background: #f0f4ff;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.btn-refresh:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

.btn-spinner {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  border-top-color: var(--jl-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.75s linear infinite;
  display: inline-block;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

/* ── Alert ── */
.alert-error {
  background: #fff3f2;
  border: 1px solid #f8d3d0;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  color: var(--jl-danger);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

/* ── Stats row ── */
.stats-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.stat-card {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.04);
  transition: box-shadow 0.18s, transform 0.12s;
}

.stat-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.09);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.stat-card--ats {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fafbff, #f5f0ff);
  border-color: #e4d9ff;
}

.stat-icon-wrap {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.stat-icon {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.stat-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.1rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.stat-value {
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  line-height: 1;
  display: block;
}

.stat-denom {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.stat-sub {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.sk-number {
  height: 28px;
  width: 60px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #e8edf7;
  animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}

/* ── Onboarding panel ── */
.onboarding-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f9ff, #eff6ff);
  border: 1px solid #c8dbff;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.1rem;
}

.ob-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.ob-progress-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.ob-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.ob-emoji {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
}

.ob-title h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.15rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.ob-title p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.ob-progress-track {
  height: 6px;
  background: rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.1);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ob-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--jl-primary), #19b27a);
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width 0.6s ease;
}

.ob-profile-link {
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.ob-steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ob-step {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.12);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.ob-step--done {
  background: rgba(25, 178, 122, 0.07);
  border-color: #b5e6ca;
}

.ob-check {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--jl-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.ob-step--done .ob-check {
  background: #19b27a;
  border-color: #19b27a;
}

.ob-step-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.ob-step-desc {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* ── Content grid ── */
.content-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
  gap: 1rem;
}

/* ── Panel ── */
.panel {
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 1.4rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.panel-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.panel-head h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.15rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.panel-sub {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.panel-link {
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── Skeletons ── */
.recommendations-skeleton,
.side-skeleton,
.application-skeleton {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.sk-job-card,
.sk-interview-card,
.sk-app-row {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.sk-line {
  height: 13px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #e8edf7;
}

.sk-line.wide {
  width: 70%;
}
.sk-line.med {
  width: 50%;
}
.sk-line.short {
  width: 35%;
}

/* ── Empty states ── */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem 1rem;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.empty-state.compact {
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.empty-icon {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  opacity: 0.3;
}

.empty-state p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  max-width: 280px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

/* ── Button actions ── */
.btn-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 0.48rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-action:hover {
  opacity: 0.85;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-primary-sm {
  background: var(--jl-primary);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.22);
}

.btn-job {
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  align-self: flex-start;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 0.38rem 0.75rem;
}

/* ── Jobs grid ── */
.jobs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.job-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  padding: 0.9rem 0.95rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.12s;
}

.job-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(13, 45, 138, 0.08);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.job-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.job-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.15rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
}

.job-company {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.match-badge {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.match-badge[data-score='high'] {
  background: #def8e9;
  color: #1f6841;
}
.match-badge[data-score='mid'] {
  background: #fef3c7;
  color: #92400e;
}
.match-badge[data-score='low'] {
  background: #f3f4f6;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.job-reason {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  line-height: 1.45;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── Interview list (sidebar) ── */
.interview-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.interview-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.interview-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.iv-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--jl-muted-text);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.iv-dot[data-status='scheduled'],
.iv-dot[data-status='draft'] {
  background: var(--jl-primary);
}

.iv-dot[data-status='live'],
.iv-dot[data-status='inprogress'],
.iv-dot[data-status='started'] {
  background: #19b27a;
  animation: blink 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes blink {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
}

.iv-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.iv-title {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.iv-date {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.iv-status-pill {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #eef3ff;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.4rem;
  width: fit-content;
}

.iv-enter {
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  font-size: 1rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: background 0.12s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.iv-enter:hover {
  background: #eef3ff;
}

/* ── Applications table ── */
.applications-table {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.app-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.app-row:hover {
  border-color: #c8d6f7;
}

.app-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.1rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.app-title {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--jl-ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.app-company {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.app-status {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.6rem;
  background: #eef3ff;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.app-status[data-status='submitted'],
.app-status[data-status='underreview'] {
  background: #fef3c7;
  color: #92400e;
}

.app-status[data-status='shortlisted'],
.app-status[data-status='accepted'],
.app-status[data-status='hired'] {
  background: #def8e9;
  color: #1f6841;
}

.app-status[data-status='rejected'],
.app-status[data-status='withdrawn'] {
  background: #fff3f2;
  color: var(--jl-danger);
}

.app-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .stats-row {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .ob-steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .content-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .jobs-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .app-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  }

  .app-date {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .stats-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .ob-steps {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

```

## frontend-angular\src\app\features\candidates\pages\dashboard\candidate-dashboard.page.html
```html
<section class="dashboard">
  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="dash-header">
    <div>
      <h1>
        Good {{ greeting() }},
        <span class="name-highlight">{{ (profile()?.fullName ?? '').split(' ')[0] || 'there' }}</span>
      </h1>
      <p>Here's your AI-curated snapshot — opportunities, interviews, and your progress.</p>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="btn-refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading()">
      @if (loading()) {
        <span class="btn-spinner"></span>
      } @else {
        <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i>
      }
      {{ loading() ? 'Loading…' : 'Refresh' }}
    </button>
  </header>

  @if (error()) {
    <div class="alert-error">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i> {{ error() }}
    </div>
  }

  <!-- Stats -->
  <div class="stats-row">
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-icon-wrap" style="background:#eef3ff">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines fa-lg" style="color:#4059aa"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-body">
        <span class="stat-label">Applications</span>
        @if (loading()) { <div class="sk-number"></div> }
        @else {
          <strong class="stat-value">{{ stats().totalApplications }}</strong>
          <span class="stat-sub">{{ stats().pendingReview }} in review</span>
        }
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-icon-wrap" style="background:#f0fdf4">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone fa-lg" style="color:#19b27a"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-body">
        <span class="stat-label">Interviews</span>
        @if (loading()) { <div class="sk-number"></div> }
        @else {
          <strong class="stat-value">{{ interviews().length }}</strong>
          <span class="stat-sub">scheduled &amp; live</span>
        }
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-icon-wrap" style="background:#fef3c7">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-star fa-lg" style="color:#d97706"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-body">
        <span class="stat-label">Best Match</span>
        @if (loading()) { <div class="sk-number"></div> }
        @else {
          <strong class="stat-value">
            {{ stats().strongestMatch !== null ? (stats().strongestMatch + '%') : '--' }}
          </strong>
          <span class="stat-sub">top AI recommendation</span>
        }
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stat-card stat-card--ats">
      <div class="stat-icon-wrap" style="background:#f5f0ff">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line fa-lg" style="color:#7c3aed"></i>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-body">
        <span class="stat-label">Best ATS Score</span>
        @if (loading()) { <div class="sk-number"></div> }
        @else {
          <strong class="stat-value">{{ atsScore() || '--' }}<span class="stat-denom">/100</span></strong>
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Onboarding Checklist -->
  @if (!onboardingComplete()) {
    <div class="onboarding-panel">
      <div class="ob-header">
        <div class="ob-progress-wrap">
          <div class="ob-title">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-rocket ob-emoji" style="color:#4059aa;font-size:1.6rem"></i>
            <div>
              <h2>Complete Your Profile</h2>
              <p>{{ onboardingCompletedCount() }}/{{ onboardingTotalCount() }} steps done — finish to unlock AI matching</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="ob-progress-track">
            <div class="ob-progress-fill"
              [style.width.%]="onboardingTotalCount() > 0 ? (onboardingCompletedCount() / onboardingTotalCount() * 100) : 0">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <a class="ob-profile-link" routerLink="/candidate/profile">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i> Go to Profile
        </a>
      </div>

      <div class="ob-steps">
        @for (step of onboardingChecklist(); track step.key) {
          <div class="ob-step" [class.ob-step--done]="step.done">
            <div class="ob-check">
              @if (step.done) { <i class="fa-solid fa-check" style="font-size:.7rem;color:#fff"></i> }
            </div>
            <span class="ob-step-label">{{ step.label }}</span>
            <span class="ob-step-desc">{{ step.description }}</span>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  <!-- Main content -->
  <div class="content-grid">
    <!-- Left: AI Recs + Applications -->
    <div class="content-left">
      <!-- AI Recommendations -->
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <div>
            <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> AI Job Matches</h2>
            <p class="panel-sub">Personalized recommendations based on your profile</p>
          </div>
          <a class="panel-link" routerLink="/candidate/recommendations">
            View all <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
          </a>
        </div>

        @if (recommendationsLoading()) {
          <div class="recommendations-skeleton">
            @for (i of [1,2]; track i) {
              <div class="sk-job-card">
                <div class="sk-line wide"></div>
                <div class="sk-line med"></div>
                <div class="sk-line short"></div>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        } @else if (recommendedJobs().length === 0) {
          <div class="empty-state">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass empty-icon"></i>
            <p>{{ recommendationNote() || 'No recommendations yet. Upload your resume and let our AI find your best matches.' }}</p>
          </div>
        } @else {
          <div class="jobs-grid">
            @for (rec of recommendedJobs().slice(0, 4); track rec.jobId) {
              <div class="job-card">
                <div class="job-card-top">
                  <div>
                    <h3 class="job-title">{{ rec.title }}</h3>
                    <p class="job-company">{{ rec.companyName || 'Company' }}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span class="match-badge" [attr.data-score]="getMatchTier(rec.matchScore)">
                    {{ rec.matchScore }}%
                  </span>
                </div>
                @if (rec.matchReason) {
                  <p class="job-reason">{{ rec.matchReason }}</p>
                }
                <a class="btn-action btn-job" [routerLink]="['/candidate/jobs', rec.jobId]">
                  View <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
                </a>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </div>

      <!-- Recent Applications -->
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <div>
            <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> Recent Applications</h2>
          </div>
          <a class="panel-link" routerLink="/candidate/applications">
            View all <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
          </a>
        </div>

        @if (loading() && applications().length === 0) {
          <div class="application-skeleton">
            @for (i of [1,2,3]; track i) {
              <div class="sk-app-row"><div class="sk-line wide"></div><div class="sk-line short"></div></div>
            }
          </div>
        } @else if (applications().length === 0) {
          <div class="empty-state compact">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-inbox empty-icon"></i>
            <p>You haven't applied to any jobs yet.</p>
          </div>
        } @else {
          <div class="applications-table">
            @for (app of applications(); track app.applicationId) {
              <div class="app-row">
                <div class="app-info">
                  <span class="app-title">{{ app.jobTitle }}</span>
                  <span class="app-company">{{ app.companyName }}</span>
                </div>
                <span
                  class="app-status"
                  [attr.data-status]="normalizeStatus(app.status)"
                >{{ normalizeStatus(app.status) }}</span>
                <span class="app-date">
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-days" style="margin-right:.3rem;opacity:.6"></i>
                  {{ app.appliedAt | date: 'MMM d' }}
                </span>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Right: Interviews sidebar -->
    <aside class="content-right">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-head">
          <div>
            <h2><i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-check" style="color:#4059aa;margin-right:.4rem"></i> Interviews</h2>
          </div>
          <a class="panel-link" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
            All <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
          </a>
        </div>

        @if (loading() && interviews().length === 0) {
          <div class="side-skeleton">
            @for (i of [1,2]; track i) {
              <div class="sk-interview-card">
                <div class="sk-line med"></div>
                <div class="sk-line short"></div>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        } @else if (interviews().length === 0) {
          <div class="empty-state compact">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-video empty-icon"></i>
            <p>No upcoming interviews scheduled.</p>
          </div>
        } @else {
          <div class="interview-list">
            @for (iv of interviews(); track iv.sessionId) {
              <div class="interview-item">
                <span class="iv-dot" [attr.data-status]="iv.status.toLowerCase()"></span>
                <div class="iv-body">
                  <span class="iv-title">{{ iv.interviewTitle || iv.jobTitle }}</span>
                  <span class="iv-date">
                    <i class="fa-regular fa-calendar"></i>
                    {{ iv.scheduledAt | date: 'MMM d, h:mm a' }}
                  </span>
                  <span class="iv-status-pill">{{ iv.status }}</span>
                </div>
                <a
                  class="iv-enter"
                  [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', iv.sessionId]"
                  title="Enter session"
                >
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>
                </a>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
```

## frontend-angular\src\app\features\candidates\pages\dashboard\candidate-dashboard.page.ts
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { catchError, finalize, forkJoin, map, of } from 'rxjs';

import { CandidateService } from '../../candidate.service';
import {
  CandidateDashboardDto,
  CandidateProfileDto,
  CandidateRecentApplicationDto,
  CandidateUpcomingInterviewDto
} from '../../../../core/models/candidate.model';
import { JobRecommendationDto } from '../../../../core/models/job.model';
import { JobsService } from '../../../jobs/jobs.service';

interface OnboardingChecklistItem {
  key: 'profile' | 'skills' | 'resume' | 'resumeParsing';
  label: string;
  description: string;
  done: boolean;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-dashboard-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-dashboard.page.html',
  styleUrl: './candidate-dashboard.page.css'
})
export class CandidateDashboardPage {
  private readonly candidateService = inject(CandidateService);
  private readonly jobsService = inject(JobsService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly recommendationsLoading = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  readonly recommendationNote = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly dashboard = signal<CandidateDashboardDto | null>(null);
  readonly profile = signal<CandidateProfileDto | null>(null);
  readonly recommendedJobs = signal<JobRecommendationDto[]>([]);
  readonly applications = signal<CandidateRecentApplicationDto[]>([]);
  readonly interviews = signal<CandidateUpcomingInterviewDto[]>([]);

  readonly atsScore = computed(() => this.dashboard()?.highestAtsScore ?? 0);

  readonly greeting = computed(() => {
    const h = new Date().getHours();
    if (h < 12) return 'morning';
    if (h < 17) return 'afternoon';
    return 'evening';
  });

  readonly stats = computed(() => {
    const d = this.dashboard();
    return {
      totalApplications: d?.totalApplications ?? 0,
      pendingReview: d?.activeApplications ?? 0,
      interviewsUpcoming: d?.interviewsScheduled ?? 0,
      strongestMatch: this.recommendedJobs()[0]?.matchScore ?? null
    };
  });

  readonly onboardingChecklist = computed<OnboardingChecklistItem[]>(() => {
    const p = this.profile();
    const hasProfileBasics = !!p?.fullName && !!p?.currentTitle && !!p?.location;
    const hasSkills = (p?.skills?.length ?? 0) > 0;
    const hasResume = (p?.resumes?.length ?? 0) > 0;
    const hasParsedResume = (p?.resumes ?? []).some((r) => r.isParsed);

    return [
      {
        key: 'profile',
        label: 'Complete profile basics',
        description: 'Add your full name, current title, and location so recruiters can discover you.',
        done: hasProfileBasics
      },
      {
        key: 'skills',
        label: 'Add at least one skill',
        description: 'Skills improve matching quality and recommendation relevance.',
        done: hasSkills
      },
      {
        key: 'resume',
        label: 'Upload your resume',
        description: 'A resume is required before you can submit applications.',
        done: hasResume
      },
      {
        key: 'resumeParsing',
        label: 'Parse your resume insights',
        description: 'Parsing generates ATS optimization insights and better AI matching.',
        done: hasParsedResume
      }
    ];
  });

  readonly onboardingCompletedCount = computed(
    () => this.onboardingChecklist().filter((i) => i.done).length
  );
  readonly onboardingTotalCount = computed(() => this.onboardingChecklist().length);
  readonly onboardingComplete = computed(
    () =>
      this.onboardingTotalCount() > 0 &&
      this.onboardingCompletedCount() === this.onboardingTotalCount()
  );

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  load(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.loadRecommendations();

    forkJoin({
      profile: this.candidateService.getProfile().pipe(
        map((res) => res.data),
        catchError(() => of(null))
      ),
      dashboard: this.candidateService.getDashboard().pipe(
        map((res) => res.data),
        catchError(() => of(null))
      )
    })
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: ({ profile, dashboard }) => {
          this.profile.set(profile);
          this.dashboard.set(dashboard);
          this.applications.set(dashboard?.recentApplications ?? []);
          this.interviews.set(dashboard?.upcomingInterviews ?? []);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.error.set('Unable to load your dashboard right now. Please refresh.');
        }
      });
  }

  getMatchTier(score: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (score === null || score === undefined) return 'unknown';
    if (score >= 80) return 'high';
    if (score >= 60) return 'mid';
    return 'low';
  }

  normalizeStatus(status: string | null | undefined): string {
    return (status ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  private loadRecommendations(): void {
    this.recommendationsLoading.set(true);
    this.recommendationNote.set(null);
    this.jobsService
      .getCandidateRecommendations(4)
      .pipe(
        finalize(() => this.recommendationsLoading.set(false))
      )
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          const recs = res.data ?? [];
          this.recommendedJobs.set(recs);
          this.recommendationNote.set(recs.length === 0 ? (res.message ?? null) : null);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.recommendedJobs.set([]);
          this.recommendationNote.set('Recommendations are unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.');
        }
      });
  }
}
```

## frontend-angular\src\app\features\candidates\pages\interviews\candidate-interview-report.page.css
```css
.report-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── Header ── */
.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.breadcrumb-link {
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.breadcrumb-link:hover {
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.breadcrumb-sep {
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.breadcrumb-current {
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
}

.header-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.header-main h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.header-main p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--jl-muted-text);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.btn-refresh {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--jl-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--jl-ink-soft);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

.btn-refresh:hover:not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--jl-primary);
  background: #f0f4ff;
  color: var(--jl-primary);
}

.btn-refresh:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: wait;
}

.btn-spinner {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  border-top-color: var(--jl-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

/* ── Skeleton ── */
.report-skeleton {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.sk-hero {

}

}

  background: #e8edf7;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {

  }
}

/* ── Error ── */
.report-error {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 4rem 2rem;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--jl-surface);

}

/* Score ring */
.score-section {

/* Events breakdown */

}

  color: #b45309;
  background: #fef3c7;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.08rem 0.4rem;
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .report-hero {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .score-section {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-stats {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .timing-row {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .feedback-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .integrity-stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .sk-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .integrity-stats {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .header-main {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .q-score-wrap {
    display: none;
  }
}
```

```html
<section class="report-page">
  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="page-header">
    <div class="breadcrumb">
      <a routerLink="/candidate/interviews" class="breadcrumb-link">← Interviews</a>
      @if (sessionId()) {
        <span class="breadcrumb-sep">/</span>
        <a [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', sessionId()]" class="breadcrumb-link">
          Session
        </a>
        <span class="breadcrumb-sep">/</span>
        <span class="breadcrumb-current">Report</span>
      }
    </div>
    <div class="header-main">
      <div>
        <h1>Interview Report</h1>
        <p>AI-generated evaluation of your interview session performance</p>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="btn-refresh" (click)="load()" [disabled]="loading()">
        @if (loading()) {
          <span class="btn-spinner"></span>
        }
        {{ loading() ? 'Loading...' : '🔄 Refresh' }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Loading -->
  @if (loading() && !report()) {
    <div class="report-skeleton">
      <div class="sk-hero"></div>
      <div class="sk-grid">
        <div class="sk-card"></div>
        <div class="sk-card"></div>
        <div class="sk-card"></div>
        <div class="sk-card"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  <!-- Error -->
  @if (error() && !loading()) {
    <div class="report-error">
      <span class="error-icon">📋</span>
      <h2>Report Unavailable</h2>
      <p>{{ error() }}</p>
      <button type="button" class="btn-retry" (click)="load()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
  }

  @if (report(); as r) {
    <!-- Hero: Score + Summary -->
    <div class="report-hero">
      <!-- Score ring -->
      <div class="score-section">
        @if (r.overallScore !== null && r.overallScore !== undefined) {
          <div class="score-ring">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 140 140" width="140" height="140">
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="rg" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0d2d8a" />
                  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#19b27a" />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <circle class="ring-track" cx="70" cy="70" r="60" />
              <circle
                class="ring-fill"
                cx="70"
                cy="70"
                r="60"
                [attr.stroke-dasharray]="377"
                [attr.stroke-dashoffset]="377 - 377 * (r.overallScore / 100)"
              />
            </svg>
            <div class="ring-inner">
              <span class="ring-number">{{ r.overallScore | number: '1.0-0' }}</span>
              <span class="ring-100">/100</span>
              <span class="ring-label">Overall Score</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        } @else {
          <div class="score-pending">
            <span class="score-pending-icon">⏳</span>
            <p>Score pending</p>
          </div>
        }
      </div>

      <!-- Session meta -->
      <div class="hero-info">
        <h2 class="hero-job">{{ r.jobTitle }}</h2>
        <p class="hero-candidate">🧑 {{ r.candidateName }}</p>

        <div class="hero-stats">
          <div class="hero-stat">
            <span class="hs-label">Duration</span>
            <span class="hs-value">{{ r.durationMinutes }} min</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-stat">
            <span class="hs-label">Questions</span>
            <span class="hs-value">{{ r.questionScores.length }}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-stat">
            <span class="hs-label">Integrity</span>
            <span class="hs-value" [class.flag-red]="r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected">
              {{ r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected ? '⚠️ Flagged' : '✅ Clean' }}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-stat">
            <span class="hs-label">Events</span>
            <span class="hs-value">{{ r.cheatingReport.totalEvents }}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="timing-row">
          @if (r.startedAt) {
            <span class="timing-chip">▶ Started {{ r.startedAt | date: 'MMM d, h:mm a' }}</span>
          }
          @if (r.endedAt) {
            <span class="timing-chip">⏹ Ended {{ r.endedAt | date: 'h:mm a' }}</span>
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- AI Feedback -->
    @if (r.aiFeedback || r.recommendation) {
      <div class="feedback-grid">
        @if (r.aiFeedback) {
          <div class="feedback-card feedback-ai">
            <div class="fc-header">
              <span class="fc-icon">🤖</span>
              <h3>AI Feedback</h3>
            </div>
            <p>{{ r.aiFeedback }}</p>
          </div>
        }
        @if (r.recommendation) {
          <div class="feedback-card feedback-rec">
            <div class="fc-header">
              <span class="fc-icon">💡</span>
              <h3>Recommendation</h3>
            </div>
            <p>{{ r.recommendation }}</p>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    }

    <!-- Question breakdown -->
    <div class="section-card">
      <div class="section-head">
        <div>
          <h3>Question-by-Question Breakdown</h3>
          <p class="section-sub">AI scores and feedback for each interview question</p>
        </div>
        <span class="count-badge">{{ r.questionScores.length }} questions</span>
      </div>

      @if (r.questionScores.length === 0) {
        <div class="empty-section">
          <span>No question scores available yet.</span>
        </div>
      } @else {
        <div class="questions-list">
          @for (q of r.questionScores; track q.questionText; let i = $index) {
            <article class="q-card" [class.q-card--high]="(q.score ?? 0) >= 75" [class.q-card--low]="(q.score ?? 100) < 50">
              <div class="q-header">
                <div class="q-num">Q{{ i + 1 }}</div>
                <div class="q-meta">
                  @if (q.category) {
                    <span class="q-category">{{ q.category }}</span>
                  }
                </div>
                @if (q.score !== null && q.score !== undefined) {
                  <div class="q-score-wrap">
                    <div
                      class="q-score-bar-bg"
                      [attr.title]="'Score: ' + q.score"
                    >
                      <div
                        class="q-score-bar-fill"
                        [style.width.%]="q.score"
                        [class.fill-high]="q.score >= 75"
                        [class.fill-mid]="q.score >= 50 && q.score < 75"
                        [class.fill-low]="q.score < 50"
                      ></div>
                    </div>
                    <span class="q-score-num">{{ q.score | number: '1.0-0' }}</span>
                  </div>
                } @else {
                  <span class="q-score-pending">—</span>
                }
              </div>
              <p class="q-text">{{ q.questionText }}</p>
              @if (q.feedback) {
                <div class="q-feedback">
                  <span class="q-feedback-icon">💬</span>
                  <span>{{ q.feedback }}</span>
                </div>
              }
            </article>
          }
        </div>
      }
    </div>

    <!-- Integrity report -->
    <div class="integrity-report">
      <div class="section-head">
        <div>
          <h3>Integrity Report</h3>
          <p class="section-sub">Browser activity and proctoring signals captured during the session</p>
        </div>
        <span
          class="integrity-badge"
          [class.integrity-clean]="!r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected"
          [class.integrity-flagged]="r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected"
        >
          {{ r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected ? '⚠️ Issues Detected' : '✅ Clean Session' }}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div class="integrity-stats">
        <div class="int-stat">
          <span class="int-label">Tab Switches</span>
          <strong class="int-val" [class.int-flag]="r.cheatingReport.totalTabSwitches > 0">
            {{ r.cheatingReport.totalTabSwitches }}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div class="int-stat">
          <span class="int-label">Focus Losses</span>
          <strong class="int-val" [class.int-flag]="r.cheatingReport.totalFocusLosses > 2">
            {{ r.cheatingReport.totalFocusLosses }}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div class="int-stat">
          <span class="int-label">Total Events</span>
          <strong class="int-val" [class.int-flag]="r.cheatingReport.totalEvents > 0">
            {{ r.cheatingReport.totalEvents }}
          </strong>
        </div>
        <div class="int-stat">
          <span class="int-label">Verdict</span>
          <strong class="int-val" [class.int-flag]="r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected">
            {{ r.cheatingReport.cheatingDetected ? 'Flagged' : 'Clear' }}
          </strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      @if (eventRows().length > 0) {
        <div class="event-breakdown">
          <h4>Events by type</h4>
          <div class="event-chips">
            @for (row of eventRows(); track row[0]) {
              <div class="event-chip">
                <span class="ec-name">{{ row[0] }}</span>
                <span class="ec-count">{{ row[1] }}</span>
              </div>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

## frontend-angular\src\app\features\candidates\pages\interviews\candidate-interview-report.page.ts
```ts
import { CommonModule, DatePipe, DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { finalize } from 'rxjs';

import { InterviewsService } from '../../../interviews/interviews.service';
import { InterviewReportDto } from '../../../../core/models/interview.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-candidate-interview-report-page',
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink, DatePipe, DecimalPipe],
  templateUrl: './candidate-interview-report.page.html',
  styleUrls: ['./candidate-interview-report.page.css']
})
export class CandidateInterviewReportPage {
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private readonly interviewsService = inject(InterviewsService);

  readonly loading = signal(true);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly sessionId = signal<number | null>(null);
  readonly report = signal<InterviewReportDto | null>(null);

  readonly eventRows = computed(() =>
    Object.entries(this.report()?.cheatingReport.eventsByType ?? {})
  );

  readonly avgScore = computed(() => {
    const scores = (this.report()?.questionScores ?? [])
      .map((q) => q.score)
      .filter((s): s is number => s !== null && s !== undefined);
    if (!scores.length) return null;
    return Math.round(scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length);
  });

  constructor() {
    this.route.paramMap.subscribe((params) => {
      const rawId = Number(params.get('sessionId'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(rawId) || rawId <= 0) {
        this.loading.set(false);
        this.error.set('Invalid interview session identifier provided.');
        return;
      }
      this.sessionId.set(rawId);
      this.load();
    });
  }

  load(): void {
    const id = this.sessionId();
    if (!id) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);

    this.interviewsService
      .getReport(id)
      .pipe(finalize(() => this.loading.set(false)))
      .subscribe({
        next: (res) => {
          this.report.set(res.data);
          if (!res.data) {
            this.error.set(
              'The interview report is not yet available. It may still be processing.'
            );
          }
        },
        error: (err: unknown) =>
          this.error.set(this.mapError(err, 'Unable to load interview report right now.'))
      });
  }

  private mapError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    if (err instanceof Error && err.message) return err.message;
    return fallback;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/* Target the direct host element */

.btn-start-session:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.04); }
.btn-start-session:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   LIVE SESSION
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.live-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f8f9fb;
}

.live-main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 2rem;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* ── AI Arena ── */
.arena-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
}

.ai-arena {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #1e3a8a 0%, #00164e 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 22, 78, 0.4);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Orb background layers */
.orb-layer {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(40px);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.orb-blue {
  width: 80%;
  height: 80%;
  top: -10%;
  left: -10%;
  background: #4059aa;
  opacity: 0.35;
  animation: orb-pulse 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.orb-teal {
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  bottom: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  background: #10b981;
  opacity: 0.25;
  animation: orb-pulse 10s ease-in-out infinite 2s;
}

@keyframes orb-pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.3; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.45; }
}

/* Kinetic rings */
.kinetic-orbit {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.orbit-outer {
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;
  animation: orbit-rotate 20s linear infinite;
  border-color: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.15);
}

.orbit-inner {
  width: 190px;
  height: 190px;
  animation: orbit-rotate 14s linear infinite reverse;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

@keyframes orbit-rotate {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* AI Core glow */
.ai-core-glow {
  position: absolute;
  width: 180px;
  height: 180px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.3) 0%, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0) 70%);
  filter: blur(24px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Waveform bars */
.waveform-center {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 5px;
  height: 64px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.wave-bar {
  width: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  border-radius: 4px;
  animation: wave-idle 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin: bottom;
  min-height: 8px;
}

.wave-bar:nth-child(3n) { background: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.85); }
.wave-bar:nth-child(3n+1) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); }

.wave-bar--speaking {
  animation: wave-bounce 0.65s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}

@keyframes wave-idle {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35); opacity: 0.45; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(0.65); opacity: 0.75; }
}

@keyframes wave-bounce {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.3); }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

/* AI Status label */
.ai-status-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 3;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ai-status-label span {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

/* PiP camera */
.pip-container {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  width: 192px;
  height: 128px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #2a2a3d;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  z-index: 5;
}

.pip-video {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.pip-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: #6b7280;
  background: #374151;
}

.pip-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 6px;
  left: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.18rem 0.45rem;
}

.pip-live-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #4edea3;
  animation: live-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ── Controls Bar ── */
.controls-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.timer-pill,
.progress-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #191c1e;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}

.timer-pill i,
.progress-pill i {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #4059aa;
}

.btn-end-interview {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  background: #ba1a1a;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(186, 26, 26, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-end-interview:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.04); }
.btn-end-interview:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

.btn-control-circle {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  background: #fff;
  color: #444651;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
}

.btn-control-circle:hover { border-color: #4059aa; color: #4059aa; }
.btn-control--active { background: #e7e8ea; }

/* ── Transcript Panel ── */
.transcript-panel {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.transcript-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edeef0;
}

.transcript-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #515f74;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.transcript-title i { color: #4059aa; }

.ai-active-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #00311f;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.7rem;
  background: rgba(78, 222, 163, 0.15);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.ai-active-chip i { color: #27c38a; }

.transcript-feed {
  padding: 1.5rem;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

.transcript-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.transcript-empty-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: #c5c5d3;
}

.transcript-empty p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #757682;
}

/* Bubbles */
.transcript-bubble {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.bubble-avatar {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.bubble--ai .bubble-avatar { background: #1e3a8a; color: #fff; }
.bubble--candidate .bubble-avatar { background: #e7e8ea; color: #444651; }
.bubble--system .bubble-avatar { background: #d5e3fc; color: #515f74; }

.bubble-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.bubble-role {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #757682;
}

.bubble-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.bubble--candidate .bubble-text { font-style: italic; opacity: 0.85; }

.bubble-speaking::after {
  content: ' ▌';
  animation: cursor-blink 0.8s step-end infinite;
  color: #4059aa;
}

@keyframes cursor-blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Integrity bar */
.integrity-bar {
  margin: 0.5rem 1.5rem 1rem;
  background: #fffbeb;
  border: 1px solid #fde68a;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #92400e;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* ── Confirm End Dialog ── */
.confirm-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(25, 28, 30, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.confirm-dialog {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 2.5rem;
  max-width: 420px;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.confirm-icon {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ffdad6;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: #ba1a1a;
}

.confirm-dialog h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.confirm-dialog p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #515f74;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.confirm-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.btn-confirm-cancel {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #444651;
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.btn-confirm-cancel:hover { border-color: #4059aa; }

.btn-confirm-end {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #ba1a1a;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-confirm-end:hover:not(:disabled) { opacity: 0.9; }
.btn-confirm-end:disabled, .btn-confirm-cancel:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   COMPLETED SCREEN
═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.completed-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #f8f9fb;
}

.completed-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 3rem 2rem;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.completed-icon {
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2rem;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
}

.completed-body h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #191c1e;
}

.completed-body > p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #515f74;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  max-width: 460px;
}

.completed-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.completed-stats .stat-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e2e4;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #444651;
}

.completed-stats .stat-chip i { color: #4059aa; }

.completed-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn-view-report {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00236f, #4059aa);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(64, 89, 170, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.12s;
}

.btn-view-report:hover { transform: scale(1.03); }

.btn-back-interviews {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #c5c5d3;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #444651;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}

.btn-back-interviews:hover { border-color: #4059aa; color: #4059aa; }

/* ── Session Footer ── */
.session-footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.session-footer p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #9ca3af;
}

/* ── Shared spinner ── */
.btn-spinner {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  border-top-color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: jl-spin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes jl-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .precheck-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .controls-bar { gap: 0.6rem; }
  .btn-end-interview span { display: none; }

  .pip-container {
    width: 120px;
    height: 80px;
    bottom: 8px;
    right: 8px;
  }

  .precheck-shell .session-nav,
  .live-shell .session-nav,
  .completed-shell .session-nav {
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  }
}
```

## frontend-angular\src\app\features\candidates\pages\interviews\candidate-interview-session.page.html
```html
<!-- ── Loading ── -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'loading') {
  <div class="session-loading">
    <div class="loading-spinner"></div>
    <p>Loading your interview session…</p>
  </div>
}

<!-- ── Error ── -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'error') {
  <div class="session-error">
    <div class="error-icon-wrap">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
    </div>
    <h2>Session Unavailable</h2>
    <p>{{ error() || 'This interview session could not be loaded.' }}</p>
    <a class="btn-back" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back to Interviews
    </a>
  </div>
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     PRE-CHECK SCREEN
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'pre-check' && session(); as s) {
  <div class="precheck-shell">
    <!-- Top bar -->
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span class="nav-label">Interview Pre-Check</span>
      <a class="btn-nav-back" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back
      </a>
    </nav>

    <div class="precheck-body">
      <!-- Title -->
      <div class="precheck-intro">
        <h1>{{ s.interviewTitle || s.jobTitle }}</h1>
        <p>{{ s.jobTitle }} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {{ s.agentType }} AI Agent Interview</p>
      </div>

      <div class="precheck-cards">
        <!-- Camera & Mic card -->
        <div class="check-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i> Camera &amp; Microphone</h3>

          <div class="camera-preview-wrap">
            @if (cameraStream()) {
              <video #previewVideo autoplay muted playsinline class="preview-video"></video>
            } @else {
              <div class="no-camera-placeholder">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-camera-slash no-cam-icon"></i>
                <span>Camera not enabled</span>
                <small>Grant access below to preview your camera</small>
              </div>
            }
          </div>

          <ul class="perm-list">
            <li class="perm-item" [class.perm-granted]="permissionsGranted().mic" [class.perm-denied]="permChecked() && !permissionsGranted().mic">
              <span class="perm-dot"></span>
              <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone perm-icon"></i>
              Microphone
              @if (permissionsGranted().mic) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-ok"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Ready</span>
              } @else if (permChecked()) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-fail"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Denied — required</span>
              } @else {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-pending">Not checked</span>
              }
            </li>
            <li class="perm-item" [class.perm-granted]="permissionsGranted().camera" [class.perm-denied]="permChecked() && !permissionsGranted().camera">
              <span class="perm-dot"></span>
              <i class="fa-solid fa-camera perm-icon"></i>
              Camera
              @if (permissionsGranted().camera) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-ok"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Ready</span>
              } @else if (permChecked()) {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-fail"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i> Denied — required</span>
              } @else {
                <span class="perm-badge perm-pending">Not checked</span>
              }
            </li>
          </ul>

          @if (!hasRequiredPermissions()) {
            <button class="btn-grant-perms" type="button" (click)="requestPermissions()" [disabled]="requestingPerms()">
              @if (requestingPerms()) {
                <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Requesting access…
              } @else {
                <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i> Grant Mic &amp; Camera Access
              }
            </button>
          }
        </div>

        <!-- Guidelines card -->
        <div class="check-card">
          <h3><i class="fa-solid fa-clipboard-list"></i> Interview Guidelines</h3>
          <ul class="rules-list">
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i> Find a quiet environment with good lighting</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> Keep your camera on and look directly at the screen</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-ban"></i> Do not switch browser tabs during the interview</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i> Speak clearly — the AI will transcribe your responses</li>
            <li><i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> Each response has a suggested time limit</li>
          </ul>

          @if (hasBrowserEvents()) {
            <div class="browser-events-warning">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i>
              {{ totalBrowserEvents() }} integrity event(s) detected
            </div>
          }
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Start button -->
      <div class="precheck-cta">
        @if (!hasRequiredPermissions()) {
          <p class="cta-note">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i>
            Grant microphone and camera access before starting.
          </p>
        }
        <button
          class="btn-start-session"
          type="button"
          (click)="enterInterview()"
          [disabled]="acting() || !hasRequiredPermissions()"
        >
          @if (acting()) {
            <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Starting…
          } @else {
            <i class="fa-solid fa-play"></i> Start Interview
          }
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     LIVE SESSION
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if ((interviewPhase() === 'in-progress' || interviewPhase() === 'completing') && session(); as s) {
  <div class="live-shell">

    <!-- ── Top Nav ── -->
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="live-badge">
        <span class="live-dot"></span>
        <span>Live Session</span>
      </div>
    </nav>

    <main class="live-main">
      <!-- ── AI Arena ── -->
      <div class="arena-wrap">
        <div class="ai-arena">
          <!-- Background orb layers -->
          <div class="orb-layer orb-blue"></div>
          <div class="orb-layer orb-teal"></div>

          <!-- Kinetic rotating rings -->
          <div class="kinetic-orbit orbit-outer"></div>
          <div class="kinetic-orbit orbit-inner"></div>

          <!-- AI Core glow -->
          <div class="ai-core-glow"></div>

          <!-- Central waveform bars -->
          <div class="waveform-center">
            @for (bar of waveformBars; track bar.delay) {
              <div
                class="wave-bar"
                [class.wave-bar--speaking]="audioPlaying() || liveCapturing()"
                [style.animation-duration]="bar.dur + 's'"
                [style.animation-delay]="bar.delay + 's'"
                [style.height.px]="bar.h"
              ></div>
            }
          </div>

          <!-- AI status label -->
          <div class="ai-status-label">
            @if (audioPlaying()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i> AI Speaking</span>
            } @else if (aiSpeechMode() === 'fallback') {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-volume-high"></i> AI Voice (Fallback)</span>
            } @else if (liveCapturing()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i> Listening…</span>
            } @else if (isRealtimeConnecting()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> Connecting…</span>
            } @else if (aiConnected()) {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-plug-circle-check"></i> AI Connected</span>
            } @else {
              <span><i class="fa-solid fa-stars"></i> AI Ready</span>
            }
          </div>

          <!-- PiP candidate camera -->
          <div class="pip-container">
            @if (cameraStream()) {
              <video #arenaVideo autoplay muted playsinline class="pip-video"></video>
            } @else {
              <div class="pip-placeholder">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i>
              </div>
            }
            <div class="pip-label">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i> You
            </div>
            <div class="pip-live-dot"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Controls Bar ── -->
      <div class="controls-bar">
        <!-- Timer -->
        <div class="timer-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-stopwatch"></i>
          <span>{{ formattedTimer() }}</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Progress -->
        <div class="progress-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i>
          <span>{{ answeredCount() }} / {{ totalCount() }}</span>
        </div>

        <!-- End interview -->
        <button
          class="btn-end-interview"
          type="button"
          (click)="endSession()"
          [disabled]="acting()"
        >
          <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>
          <span>End Interview</span>
        </button>

        <!-- Realtime status -->
        @if (canUseRealtime()) {
          @if (!isRealtimeConnected()) {
            <button class="btn-control-circle" type="button" (click)="connectRealtime()" title="Reconnect AI">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-rotate" [class.fa-spin]="isRealtimeConnecting()"></i>
            </button>
          } @else {
            <button
              class="btn-control-circle btn-control--active"
              type="button"
              [disabled]="true"
              title="Microphone is locked during live interview"
            >
              <i class="fa-solid fa-microphone"></i>
            </button>
          }
        }

        <div class="progress-pill">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-camera"></i>
          <span>{{ cameraMonitoringActive() ? 'Camera Monitoring Active' : 'Camera Monitoring Idle' }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Live Transcript ── -->
      <div class="transcript-panel">
        <div class="transcript-header">
          <h3 class="transcript-title">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i> Live Conversation
          </h3>
          <div class="ai-active-chip">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i>
            AI Active
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="transcript-feed" #transcriptFeed>
          @if (!hasTranscripts()) {
            <div class="transcript-empty">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-comment-dots transcript-empty-icon"></i>
              <p>The conversation will appear here once the interview begins.</p>
            </div>
          }

          @for (entry of transcriptEntries(); track entry.createdAtIso) {
            <div class="transcript-bubble" [class.bubble--ai]="entry.role === 'assistant'" [class.bubble--candidate]="entry.role === 'candidate'" [class.bubble--system]="entry.role === 'system'">
              <div class="bubble-avatar">
                @if (entry.role === 'assistant') {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-robot"></i>
                } @else if (entry.role === 'candidate') {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i>
                } @else {
                  <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i>
                }
              </div>
              <div class="bubble-body">
                <span class="bubble-role">
                  @if (entry.role === 'assistant') { Interviewer }
                  @else if (entry.role === 'candidate') { You }
                  @else { System }
                </span>
                <p class="bubble-text" [class.bubble-speaking]="entry.role === 'candidate' && liveCapturing()">
                  {{ entry.text }}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <!-- Integrity warning -->
        @if (hasBrowserEvents()) {
          <div class="integrity-bar">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved"></i>
            {{ totalBrowserEvents() }} integrity event(s) logged
          </div>
        }
        @if (hasProctoringEvents()) {
          <div class="integrity-bar">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-video"></i>
            Live camera alerts: {{ proctoringEvents().join(' | ') }}
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </main>

    <footer class="session-footer">
      <p>JobLens Kinetic &nbsp;•&nbsp; Secure Candidate Environment</p>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- ── End Session Confirm Dialog ── -->
  @if (confirmEndSessionOpen()) {
    <div class="confirm-overlay">
      <div class="confirm-dialog">
        <div class="confirm-icon">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i>
        </div>
        <h2>End Interview?</h2>
        <p>This will finalize your session. You cannot re-enter once ended.</p>
        <div class="confirm-actions">
          <button class="btn-confirm-cancel" type="button" (click)="confirmEndSessionOpen.set(false)" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Continue Session
          </button>
          <button class="btn-confirm-end" type="button" (click)="confirmEndSession()" [disabled]="acting()">
            @if (acting()) {
              <span class="btn-spinner"></span> Ending…
            } @else {
              <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i> End Now
            }
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

  @if (leaveWarningOpen()) {
    <div class="confirm-overlay">
      <div class="confirm-dialog">
        <div class="confirm-icon">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-door-open"></i>
        </div>
        <h2>Leaving Is Restricted</h2>
        <p>
          This is your first leave attempt. If you try to leave again, the interview will end automatically and your score will be computed from captured answers.
        </p>
        <div class="confirm-actions">
          <button class="btn-confirm-cancel" type="button" (click)="dismissLeaveWarning()" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Continue Interview
          </button>
          <button class="btn-confirm-end" type="button" (click)="endSessionAfterLeaveWarning()" [disabled]="acting()">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-phone-slash"></i> End Interview Now
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }
}

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════
     COMPLETED
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
@if (interviewPhase() === 'completed') {
  <div class="completed-shell">
    <nav class="session-nav">
      <div class="nav-brand">
        <div class="brand-icon-wrap">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-briefcase"></i>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span class="brand-name">JobLens</span>
          <span class="brand-sub">Enterprise Recruiting</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>

    <div class="completed-body">
      <div class="completed-icon">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i>
      </div>
      <h1>Interview Complete!</h1>
      <p>
        Great work! Your responses have been recorded and will be reviewed by our AI.
        You'll be notified once your report is ready.
      </p>

      <div class="completed-stats">
        <div class="stat-chip">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i>
          {{ answeredCount() }} / {{ totalCount() }} Questions
        </div>
        <div class="stat-chip">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-stopwatch"></i>
          {{ formattedTimer() }} Elapsed
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="completed-actions">
        <a class="btn-view-report" [routerLink]="['/candidate/interviews', sessionId(), 'report']">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-chart-bar"></i> View My Report
        </a>
        <a class="btn-back-interviews" routerLink="/candidate/interviews">
          <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> All Interviews
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="session-footer">
      <p>JobLens Kinetic &nbsp;•&nbsp; Secure Candidate Environment</p>
    </footer>
  </div>
}
```
